# Shrub

> Shrub - Making Lending Accessible. Shrub Lend: borrow USDC against ETH at a rate that locks the moment you borrow. Built on Aave V3, on Base. By Shrub Finance, Inc.

This file is the text of https://shrub.finance/ for language models. The page is the source of truth.

## We believe you should never have to sell what you believe in.

You bought ETH because you believe in where it is going. Then life needs cash, and crypto tells you to sell, or to borrow at a rate that can change overnight.

Everywhere else, people borrow against what they own and keep it. That is how homes get bought and businesses get built.

Holders deserve the same.
That is why Shrub exists.

## So we take the risk that used to be yours.

1. Your ETH goes into Aave and earns yield while it is locked.
2. Borrow a small slice of its value, and that yield offsets the cost. That is how a rate can start from 0%.
3. When the market's rate jumps, Shrub's own capital covers the difference. Your rate stays fixed for 90 days, then renews at the current rate for your tier.

Simple is not the same as easy. We kept cutting until nothing needed explaining.

## What came out is one thing.

What came out is one thing. A loan against your ETH, at a rate that locks the moment you borrow.

Say you have $10,000 in ETH. How much do you need?

- Borrow $2,000: from 0%
- Borrow $2,500: from 1%
- Borrow $3,333: from 5%
- Borrow $5,000: from 8%

Your rate is locked for 90 days. A floating rate changes every day.

1% origination fee. No early repayment penalty.

Example numbers.

Borrow less, pay less. **The way loans are supposed to work.**

It is still a loan. If the price of ETH falls far enough, some of your ETH can be sold to repay it.

## Most of crypto builds for the wave. Launch. Hype. Leave.

The Last Builders are the ones still here when it passes.

A rate you agreed to is a promise.
Things worth using get built slowly.
No outside money. Nobody to answer to but the people who use it.

**Live on Base since August 2026.** Real ETH. Real USDC. Every locked rate honored.

Everyone who tested it from day one is still here.

The thing working is the proof we have.

## This is not open to everyone. Not yet.

It is for holders who never came to crypto for fast money.

If you believe what we believe, you are not a user here.
You are a Last Builder.
Build with us.

Email connect@shrub.finance and we will put you on the Last Builders waitlist.
